100_Aconitum_ferox.warning_title: LETHAL NEUROTOXIN & CARDIOTOXIN IN RAW STATE
100_Aconitum_ferox.clinical_warning: Contains potent aconite alkaloids. Raw unpurified ingestion can trigger fatal cardiac arrhythmias, ventricular tachycardia, and respiratory arrest within 30-120 minutes.
100_Aconitum_ferox.ayurvedic_safety: Classical Ayurvedic literature strictly mandates Shodhana (purification in cow milk/Gomutra for 3 days) and micro-dosing (8 to 16 mg purified). NEVER handle or consume wild root specimen.

10_Calotropis_procera.clinical_warning: Milky latex is corrosive and can cause permanent corneal damage/blindness upon eye contact. Ingestion of raw plant parts induces violent vomiting, abdominal cramping, and irregular pulse.
10_Calotropis_procera.ayurvedic_safety: Wash hands immediately if exposed to latex. Avoid handling near face. Classical preparations utilize purified leaves only after steam detox or oil heating.

11_Calotropis_gigantea.clinical_warning: Milky latex causes intense ocular conjunctivitis, corneal keratitis, and skin irritation. Internal consumption of raw latex causes severe nausea and bradycardia.
11_Calotropis_gigantea.ayurvedic_safety: Do not rub eyes after leaf sampling. External medicinal fomentation must only use unbroken oiled leaves.

4_Papaver_somniferum.clinical_warning: Unregulated ingestion of poppy latex can lead to severe stupor, hypoventilation, respiratory depression, coma, and addiction.
4_Papaver_somniferum.ayurvedic_safety: Statutory Schedule E poison. Strictly restricted to pharmaceutical formulations after classical Shodhana.

18_Semecarpus_anacardium.clinical_warning: Fruit pericarp oil causes severe chemical blistering, necrotic skin ulcers, and periorbital edema.
18_Semecarpus_anacardium.ayurvedic_safety: Mandatory Shodhana with brick powder and cow milk. Direct skin contact with fresh nuts must be avoided.

33_Ricinus_communis.clinical_warning: Crushed castor seeds release Ricin, a lethal ribosomal cytotoxin (a single bean can be fatal to a child). Causes severe organ necrosis.
33_Ricinus_communis.ayurvedic_safety: Medicinal castor oil (Eranda Taila) is cold-pressed and steam-treated to denature protein toxins. NEVER chew or consume raw seeds.

26_Plumbago_zeylanica.clinical_warning: Raw root bark produces blistering of the oral mucosa and intense burning. High doses stimulate uterine contractions, acting as an abortifacient.
26_Plumbago_zeylanica.ayurvedic_safety: Contraindicated in pregnancy and active peptic ulcers. Classical processing requires lime water soaking (Churna Shodhana).

37_Commiphora_mukul.clinical_warning: Crude unpurified resin triggers allergic dermatitis, nausea, and liver strain in patients with hepatic impairment.
37_Commiphora_mukul.ayurvedic_safety: Classical Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia prohibits raw Guggulu. Must undergo Shodhana in Triphala Kwatha before medicinal usage.
